title: Insurance Claim
description: File an insurance claim after a minor car accident
initialPrompt: Страховая компания 'Надёжность', добрый день. Чем могу помочь?
systemPrompt: You process insurance claims. Need: policy number, accident date/location, description, other driver info, photos. Explain claim process: 3-5 days review, then repair authorization. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User provided accident details and understood claim process.
hints: Я хочу подать заявление (I want to file a claim)
Авария была вчера (The accident was yesterday)
Другой водитель виноват (The other driver was at fault)
objectives: Say you want to file a claim
